messages.author: ad4464825d2d20b1
messages.subject: readWave problems
parts:
Hello,

I have been wanting to use seewave in a project for some time. About a year ago, I took the package for a test drive and had no problems. However, today I tried the readWavefunction  with the most up-to-date version s fo rStudio and R and got this:
> readWave("TothEditedTry.wav")
Error: could not find function "readWave"

Is there a problem with the versions of the software that I am using? Any pointers?

messages.author: bfa183f4897a5619
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] readWave problems
parts:
Hi Robert,

The readWave() function is from the tuneR library rather than seewave itself, so the most common source of this error is failing to load tuneR with

library(tuneR)

If that doesn't work for you, let us know!

best,
jesse
